 Tomorrowland Belgium 2027 Confirms Festival Dates for Two Weekends in July
 By Klaus 
 November 18, 2026 
 All hands on deck in Wisdom Valley, where preparations for Tomorrowland Thailand are in full swing. Over in Melbourne, teams are also hard at work getting ready for the very first Australian edition of CORE. And in Alpe d’Huez, Tomorrowland Winter preparations are already underway ahead of the first snowfall and the sound of the Moosebar’s familiar après-ski tunes filling the mountains.
 But closer to home, things are moving just as fast. In Antwerp, preparations for the next Belgian edition of Tomorrowland are already well underway behind the scenes. The theme and line-up will remain under wraps until 2027, but the festival dates can already be revealed.
 In 2027, Tomorrowland will once again take over the De Schorre recreation area in Boom for two weekends: July 16–18 and July 23–25 . Time to mark those dates in your calendar!
 The ticket sale schedule has also been confirmed:
 January 29: exclusive ticket sale for residents of Boom, Rumst and the Rupel region.
 January 30: start of the Global Journey sale (travel and accommodation packages).
 February 6: start of the Pre-Sale.
 February 13: start of the WorldWide Ticket Sale.
 The theme may remain a secret for a little while longer, but the dates are firmly in the calendar. Summer 2027 already has a date with De Schorre!
 All info via https://belgium.tomorrowland.com/en/welcome/
